column1: # vanhalen1840 key (Juan Van Halen, Ejercito de Cataluna, 1840), CC BY 4.0 (Brice Dudout, Europe chiffree, 2026).
# Alphabets numbered on in succession, with homophones: rank 1 = m n o p q r s t u [10?] z (1-11) then a b c d e f g h i j l
# (12-22); rank 2 = a ... l from 24 (a 24, d 27, e 28, l 34); a also = 58 and 70 (12+46, 24+46). No k; u serves for v;
# 70 is a letter (a), not a separator or null. No word division.
# Proposed by Claude Fable 5.2 (Anthropic) from runs S1-S6 only (ciphertext-only), frozen before the held-out runs S7-S8
# were decoded (frozen/KEY.tsv, SHA-256 d4ee3937...; identical to frozen/fable-lot4-2026-11-11/KEY-PROPOSAL.tsv).
# status: attested = value read in S1-S6; interpolated / extrapolated = given by the structure, never seen in the letter.
# The 24 attested rows are the recovered key. The 40 interpolated / extrapolated rows are CONJECTURE: none occurs in the
# letter and nothing tests them (note added at integration, 12 Nov 2026; see NOTES.md).
